verdict.rationale: Poly documents its own editing surface: journal entries are Markdown files [poly-docs-12], you can attach files to entries [poly-docs-32], and the file editor has optional Vim keybindings [poly-docs-15]. That gives a thin basis for keyboard-driven writing with some media attachment. Markdown only implies headings, tables and code blocks; none of the rich formatting elements are explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, inline embedded media, editor speed or keyboard shortcuts beyond Vim mode, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor.
